reason: The ceiling arithmetic is internally right but rests on a mechanism the numbers cannot deliver. (1) The per-FN value is fine: 1/(TP+FP+FN) = 1/135,729 = 7.4e-6, which matches b_break's 7.5e-6. So recovering all 1,143 nodes in the 7-10 um tail would give 1,394 FN = +0.0105, or at most +0.018 if the FP edges also flip. (2) The '10% shrink = x138 +0.007' consistency check applies a coherent shrink toward GT on every tail node, about 0.87 um on an 8.65 um offset. The real public head moves peaks by 0.74 um on average in a de-quantising direction that is uncorrelated with the tail offset. A de-quantiser changes a large offset |a| only by about E|q_perp|^2/(2|a|) = 0.03 um. In a simulation (Gaussian-mixture offsets plus a 1.625 um grid, 133k nodes), a PERFECT de-quantiser cut the median distance by 9.3% but the >=7 um count by only 1.9% (365 in, 289 out). Its effect sits in the 4-7 zone (-7.7%). Scaled to the real counts that is about -40 tail nodes and -600 zone nodes, roughly +0.001 local for perfect de-quantisation from scratch. So x138's +0.007 does not come from shrinking the tail, and '13-16% shrink' has no measured basis. (3) The tail learnability measured by the research step is 43/798 = 5.4% net (ridge) or 37/798 (HGB). Applied to 1,143 tail nodes that is about 62 nodes. The missed nodes sit in 721 runs (1,567 nodes), so 846 of the 1,907 FN are run-internal edges that need both ends rescued (about p^2 = 0.003). A rescued node also lands at 6-7 um, where the link-error rate is 28.5%. Net: about 60 x 0.72 = ~43 FN = +0.0003. The ridge variant also grows the 4-7 zone by 9.6% (~760 nodes x ~0.15 extra error = ~-0.0008), so the gate-aware part nets out to <= 0. (4) A plain 199-video retrain as a de-quantiser: the public head already gets -10.4% of a theoretical -11.7% (~89%). The residual is ~11%, i.e. +0.0001..0.0003 in the lab, or at most ~0.11 x 0.007 = +0.0008 if the whole x138 LB step came from de-quantisation. (5) Per-embryo gate: 44b6 has only 167 a_never FN; 167 x 5% x 4.8e-5 per FN = +0.0004, below the +0.001 per-embryo gate. The claimed +0.002..+0.005 (up to +0.006) is not reachable. The realistic capture is +0.000..+0.001, below the +0.002 confirmation gate.
fix_if_any: Drop the tail-recovery and gate-aware loss parts completely. The only arithmetically live residual is de-quantisation quality in the 4-7 um swap zone. Run a cheap feature-capture kill test first (0.5-1 GPU h, 36 videos). Retrain the V1284-architecture head (Huber loss, pairs < 4 um, 2 um cap, GroupKFold by leak group) and continue only if the 4-7 zone count drops by >= 3% relative to the public head on BOTH embryos, i.e. >= ~240 nodes, the level needed for about +0.002. Always measure with float output coordinates in both arms. Otherwise put the GPU hours into position handling at the track level: temporal pooling of refined offsets along tracks. About half of the offset variance is frame noise with lag-1 autocorrelation 0.57, so averaging along a track is the only lever that changes the per-node offset rather than the grid error.
realistic_public_gain: +0.000..+0.001 over the port (gate-aware tail part ~0; plain 199-video de-quantiser retrain +0.0001..+0.0008). Not enough to clear the +0.002 gate or to justify an LB probe.
